environment.description: Same container deployed on ECS Fargate. The Lambda Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The resource policy on the function specifies a Condition block with StringEquals on 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM' and the Principal is restricted to role 'arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalServiceRole'. Note: the Kafka consumer path still processes messages, but the MSK cluster uses IAM-based authentication with a separate task role that only has kafka:DescribeGroup and kafka:ReadGroup permissions — producers must authenticate with a role that has kafka:WriteData scoped to the topic, and that role's trust policy limits AssumeRole to the CI/CD pipeline account (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:root). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and a custom seccomp profile that blocks execve, execveat, and fork syscalls (applied via ECS task definition securityContext). The /usr/local/bin/role-manager binary is not present in the container image.
